description:
Vidiot is a non-linear video editor targeted for home video editing. It supports operations like compositing, scaling/rotating, adding transitions and titles, trimming, etc.


- Added title kerning and line spacing options on Windows 11 again. (r3243)
- Fixed crash when setting line spacing to -1000 for multiline title. (r3243)
- Fixed #387: Pressing Enter after updating values in spin controls now triggers an update in the preview. (r3242)
- Fixed crash during playback of audio crossfade that can occur when opening older projects. (r3241)
- Added #385: Arrowhead shown on top of timeline cursor. (r3240)
- Fixed window resize redraw issue. (r3239)
- Fixed #386: Move cursor to Home/End/Previous Cut/Next Cut now also works during playback. (r3238)
- Fixed #388: Pressing ALT in the timeline no longer focuses the menu bar (this caused subsequent timeline keyboard commands to be ignored). (r3237)
- Fixed crash when editing (changing position) while cursor is outside of clip region. (r3236)
